prompts.terrain:
Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D dungeon puzzle game sprite sheet. Square canvas, exactly 4 columns × 4 rows, 16 equal square slots. Slot centers fixed at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% on each axis. Exactly one self-contained sprite per slot, broad empty gutters, artwork never touches slot edges, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no shadows outside their footprint. Entire background true transparent. Camera is directly overhead looking straight down, north up, orthographic, square aligned with the screen, no diagonal/isometric perspective and no horizon. Crisp hand-painted fantasy game graphics, soft top-left material shading, readable silhouettes at small display size, muted blue-charcoal stone, aged brass and restrained teal glows. Draw each named cell in exact row-major order.
Terrain sheet. Each sprite is a crisp exact axis-aligned opaque square with straight plain edges and no transparent holes. All tile squares the same size. Row 1 walkable floor textures: workshop tan-grey slate, crypt dim purple slate, archive cool warm-ivory stone, storage pale blue slate. Row 2 walkable floor: sewer damp mossy green stone, relay navy iron floor, treasury teal-and-gold stone tile, boss chamber dark warm burgundy slate. Row 3 blocked solid wall cap textures, noticeably darker and thicker-looking than corresponding floors: workshop charcoal blocks, crypt deep purple stone, archive grey blue masonry, storage slate blue masonry. Row 4 blocked wall cap textures: sewer mossy black blocks, relay dark industrial block, treasury dark teal masonry, throne dark purple basalt. Feet seen straight down. Each tile is a single tile swatch and material, no free-floating stones elsewhere, no isolated prop in terrain cells.
